items.title: 不只影響Node.js，Node2Shell漏洞恐波及其他開發工具及應用程式
items.summary: 澳洲科技媒體iTnews近期報導，Node.js日前修補的高風險漏洞Node2Shell，漏洞編號為CVE-2026-111497，可能也影響其他開發工具及應用程式。

items.title: Microsoft 365帳號遭權杖重播攻擊，79家組織受影響
items.summary: 資安業者Huntress近日揭露一波針對Microsoft 365的權杖重播攻擊（Token Replay Attack），攻擊者利用竊取自不同組織使用者的登入權杖，大量嘗試冒用使用者身分登入Microsoft 365帳號。根據該公司的調查，7月14日至9月22日期間，在79家受影響組織中，至少觀測到497次成功登入事件，以及超過20萬次失敗登入嘗試。

items.title: 加拿大匿名犯罪檢舉平臺遭駭，17.7萬筆資料外洩後暫停服務
items.summary: 加拿大多倫多匿名犯罪檢舉組織Toronto Crime Stoppers於日前宣布暫停服務。該組織使用的第三方檢舉管理系統P3今年3月遭駭，造成176,859筆檢舉紀錄外洩，部分內容可能透露原本匿名的檢舉人身分。Toronto Crime Stoppers目前已停止透過網站、電話及App接受新檢舉，多倫多警察局也宣布暫停使用Crime Stoppers服務。

items.title: 國際刑警組織掃蕩非洲網路犯罪，詐騙集團鎖定亞洲受害者
items.summary: 國際刑警組織（INTERPOL）10月22日公布跨國掃蕩網路犯罪的最新成果，美國與非洲20國執法機關在Serengeti III行動中共逮捕1,462名嫌犯、干擾10,909個惡意網路的運作，並追回超過1.05億美元非法資金。執法機關在調查中確認，共有65,929人遭網路犯罪集團鎖定，相關犯罪造成的損失超過3.85億美元。

items.summary: fix(setup): model setup hangs when the Gateway does not apply its config (#183964) Related: #183777 ## What Problem This Solves Fixes: model setup hangs, or leaves a failed candidate on disk, when the Gateway does not apply the setup's config change. For example, on first-run setup with `gateway.reload.mode: "off"`. ## User Impact When setup cannot activate a new model, it now settles and restores the previous connection. - **Before (hang):** the setup dialog never finished, and every later setup attempt said "setup is already in progress" until the Gateway restarted. - **Before (first write):** on a config OpenClaw had never written, the failed candidate and its credential stayed in place, and a Gateway restart made them live. No config, schema, protocol or migration change. ## Why This Change Was Made Setup recovery writes the previous config back, and two older defects broke that write. 1. **False "superseded" for an unchanged write.** - A deferred config write (for example setup's restore) reaches the reloader's unchanged-config handler with authored SecretRefs, not resolved values. - The handler compared it with the resolved running snapshot and saw a mismatch. It reported the write as superseded although nothing newer existed, so the retry never settled the write's receipt. - Now an unchanged candidate also matches when its secrets-source form equals the running snapshot's and resolves to the running config. - The guard against a changed resolution still yields to a newer reload. 2. **Undo compared against the in-memory candidate.** - On a config's first OpenClaw write, the write pipeline stamps `meta` migration markers that the in-memory candidate lacks. - The setup undo then reported drift and refused to restore. - The undo now uses the config that actually reached disk (`persistedSourceConfig`). - The pre-write capture stays as a fallback for a write that fails after persisting. Both defects predate #183777. They are reachable on current `main` without any revocation. ## Evidence **Production path.** Each scenario runs a real `openclaw gateway run` from this branch's build, with isolated state, token auth and the real Gateway client. A loopback HTTP fake sits behind the bundled Groq provider (synthetic key), and the current provider key is an `exec` SecretRef. The trigger is first-run API-key setup with `gateway.reload.mode: "off"`: the candidate is saved and the reloader marks it not applied, so setup runs its recovery. | Scenario | `main` `fa0bc65a7dbf` | This branch | |---|---|---| | Config with existing `meta` markers | `wizard.next` never answers; setup admission stays stuck ("already in progress") | Settles with "restored on disk… Restart the Gateway"; config restored; credential inactive; next setup admitted | | First config write (no `meta`) | `error` "Newer connection settings superseded this activation"; candidate stays on disk; credential ACTIVE; restart publishes it | Restore written: no candidate key, default model or setup profile; credential inactive; after restart the Gateway runs the restored config | | Control: activation applies normally | `done` | `done` (unchanged) | With reload off, the restored config cannot be applied live, so setup reports "restart the Gateway". That message is accurate. **Upgrade from the published release.** I installed `openclaw@2026.10.7` from npm into an isolated prefix (`OpenClaw 2026.10.7 (157d8c2)`). It ran a real Gateway and created the operator state: a provider, a stored credential, a default model and a workspace file. A Gateway built from this branch then started on that same state, a failed activation ran, and the Gateway restarted. | Scenario | After upgrade | Failed activation | Next setup | After restart | |---|---|---|---|---| | Default model + stored credential, reload off set online | intact, persisted = applied | refused before writing ("reload is disabled… restart") | admitted | original model and credential active; candidate inactive; workspace intact | | Stored credential, no explicit default | intact | refused before writing | admitted | same | | Key only as exec SecretRef | intact | refused before writing | admitted | SecretRef kept; candidate inactive | | Reload off in a hand-authored file, no `meta` | intact (file unchanged) | write → recovery → "restored on disk… Restart the Gateway" in 2.5 s; credential inactive | admitted | persisted = applied; file differs from before only by the `meta` markers the write pipeline adds; candidate not live | | Same, with `meta` markers | intact | write → recovery → "did not complete activation (failed)" in 2.2 s | admitted | file byte-identical; persisted = applied; candidate inactive | No scenario hangs or leaves setup admission held. Any OpenClaw write fills in a default model, and setup then refuses the activation before writing, so in practice only a hand-edited reload-off config reaches recovery. One known limit: in the no-`meta` case, the restore's reload logs `SetupInferenceOwnerDriftError: A newer credential update superseded this activation` while it rolls back the credential. The end state is still correct (credential rolled back, original config live after restart), but the log reason is misleading. That log comes from the existing credential-rollback owner and is not changed here. **Regression tests**, each failing on `main`'s code and passing here: - `server-reload-managed-secrets.test.ts`: an unchanged activation write with unresolved SecretRefs now settles `applied` (on `main` it never settles). - `setup-inference-activate.test.ts`: a first config write is restored when its activation is not applied. **Existing suites:** the existing guard for a changed resolution ("refreshes owner refs when only the resolved source snapshot changes") still passes. 30 focused test files pass across reload, secrets, setup activation and the wizard. `tsgo:core` and type-aware `oxlint` on the changed files are clean. Not covered: no live provider account. Full typecheck and the broad suites are left to CI. ## Merge danger Two-way door: a revert restores the previous behavior. Nothing persisted, migrated or published changes. Blast radius if wrong: - Config writes whose effective config is unchanged, in configs that use SecretRefs, could publish when they should yield to a newer reload. - Setup recovery could restore the wrong fields. The changed-resolution guard test and the production restore checks cover both. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

Keep memory-slot recovery as the representative of the shared slot-values path. Remove copied archive-limit defaults and internal preparation counts while preserving rejection, evaluation, cleanup, and authority assertions. * test(plugins): consolidate j0036 provenance and metadata proof Keep direct archive and npm-pack scenarios separate while sharing exact provenance assertions. Remove repeated channel hydration from the snapshot suite: manifest-registry-installed.test.ts retains hydrates package metadata from dot-prefixed package directories. Preserve snapshot fast-path and canonical fixture paths. CI-only static validation; no tests or builds run. * test(ui): deslop j0034 tests Share attachment, automation, timer, rendering, pin-state and diff assertion setup. Consolidate MCP App preview routing proof in the widget-card dispatch case while retaining tool-surface suppression in chat-tool-cards. Preserve 126 declarations and 194 expanded cases, including authority, media retirement, sandbox ceilings, clipboard races and streaming DOM identity. Reduce shard LOC from 5171 to 5037 (2.6%); the 20% target is not safely reachable from the remaining distinct behavior. CI-only: plain oxlint, oxfmt and diff checks passed; runtime tests and coverage deferred to hosted CI. * test(gateway): deslop j0038 tests * test(gateway): consolidate j0038 owner fixtures Keep duplicate title settlement coverage in the late-worktree title table. Control-command attachment naming remains covered by server.sessions.title-source.test.ts through chat.send. Retain every distinct cookie, path, approval, snapshot ordering, and recovery authority behavior; consolidate cookie and recovery fixtures without changing production code. * test(gateway): deslop j0037 tests Share exact model response assertions, identity fixtures and Claude opt-out setup. Consolidate nonblocking reads and SecretRef variants into tables while retaining every expanded case and auth/public projection assertion. Leave node wake and agent deletion suites unchanged to preserve distinct deadline, authority, path-identity and recovery checks. * test(codex): deslop j0039 tests Share exact command-result, live-thread, and model fixtures. Reuse the harness ordered-write waiter for incognito interrupt cleanup and consolidate conversation reply assertions without dropping cases. Retain all 101 declarations and 146 expanded cases: command authority, credential fallback, binding replacement, source lifecycle, recovery and cleanup ordering remain distinct. CI-only validation: plain oxlint, oxfmt and diff check passed; no tests or coverage run. Reduction: 5380 to 5329 lines (0.95%), below target because further identified cuts would remove distinct behavior. * test(codex): consolidate j0039 fixtures and assertions Share goal, skill, account, explicit-store and native-resume fixtures. Simplify parameter tables and repeated request assertions while preserving protocol targets, privacy, authority, credential, recovery and lifecycle checks. Reuse conversation notification and sibling-retirement fixtures; keep source cleanup and inactive binding readout coverage. No equivalent owner coverage was found for further complete-case deletion, so the 20% target remains unmet. * test(codex): remove j0039 duplicate fixture scaffolding Use the real binding store in the diagnostics confirmation race and the existing strict conversation client in eviction proof. Remove repeated status skill fixture variants; renders skills and load failures retains disabled-skill filtering and malformed/load-error coverage through the shared readEnabledCodexSkills owner. Preserve all distinct authority, redaction, recovery and ordering cases. CI-only static gates passed: oxfmt, plain oxlint, diff check. No tests or coverage run. The20% target remains unmet after owner and sibling audit; no further safe whole-case deletion was established. * test(qa-lab): deslop j0040 tests * test(state): deslop j0041 tests Reuse closed database, integrity gate, borrower and requester fixtures while preserving every distinct case and boundary assertion.
